In the bag, there will be fresh fruits, vegetables, dry produce and a loaf of bread.

source_notes: The raw official response includes 22 provider records; source page footer states last updated 22 Mar 2023. Per-row timestamps are preserved and can differ.
Directory facts are source-card values, not current availability, stock, eligibility approval, or guaranteed service. The FoodConnect FAQ says eligibility varies by provider.

Provider-reviewed status means a current or recent organization source confirmed relevant programme/contact information; it does not validate every FoodConnect field. Directory-only means programme facts have not been independently corroborated by an organization-controlled source.
No unpublished intake information, hours, diet, accessibility, or service address is inferred. Unknown locations remain null.
permission: Public information transcribed from the Government of Singapore FoodConnect directory for internal review. This is not a partner export or a grant of redistribution rights. Do not treat directory details as current stock, eligibility approval, or confirmed access without provider confirmation.

coverage.listing_scope: All rows from the site's public directory data endpoint response; response contained 22 provider records in one array. Raw response and response headers are archived under backend/data/foodconnect-sources/.
coverage.record_timestamps: Per-record timestamp is retained verbatim as source_record_timestamp_raw; formats differ and one row may use an Excel-serial-like value.
coverage.source_fact_mapping: Public provider/card summary, description, contact, email, website, supportType; each supportType's *Info frequency, recipients, dietaryPreference, deliveryMethod and regions; corresponding raw *Frequency, *Recipients, *Types, *DeliveryMethod, *EstateGroup and *DistributionDays/*DistributionDates values (including null versus blank); and public aggregate fields are retained under directory_facts. No PK/SK, agreement, internal download status, named contact person, logo metadata, internal request contact, or internal references are included.
coverage.coordinates: Null except Krsna's confirmed provider-published public meal-service address, geocoded using OneMap. Other provider office/HQ addresses are not assumed to be service or pickup points.
